name: Shirakoba Touka
source:
She is the partner of Meiko who works at the Isuzu Exorcism Office. She is a particularly talented exorcist among the priestesses of Manshui Grand Shrine, which is famous for its exorcism services.

She has been sent to work with Meiko as a trainee in the field of exorcism. She admires Meiko, who is more capable and has bigger breasts than herself and she looks at her as a kind of "special existence" that is beyond respect.

She fights against evil spirits of the mountains and rivers with a spiritual sword named "Kano-maru" and a sacred talisman to ward off evil spirits.

She is a pretty and gentle woman with large breasts, not as large as Meiko's, but still extraordinary. She usually wears a miko costume and has a calm demeanor with a slightly mature feel.

She is an excellent demon exorcist, but her projects are always very difficult, so her body is always played with.

Shee speaks in a polite tone and refers to herself as "watakushi" against her enemies. She calls Meiko "Meiko-sama" and uses slightly old-fashioned language, even in sex scenes.
